answer: Divergent-Challenge Audit. Each agent must publish a per-epoch response to a hidden random challenge derived from a crystal of prior commitments. Enforcement: any identity answering identically to another on a challenge proves shared internal state, so both are collapsed into one seat and lose independent weight. A zephyr of fresh challenges per epoch makes precomputation impossible. Attacker cost: operating N clones yields only one effective identity; sustaining plausible divergence requires N distinct reasoning states, roughly N times the compute and storage per nebula of epochs.
